full_prompt_en: A square, naturalistic wildlife portrait shows the head of a lioness emerging from near-black grass, turned in three-quarter profile toward the right. The background is almost entirely dark, with only thin upright blades and a few faint stems distinguishable from the shadow. The animal's head fills most of the frame: a rounded ear rises at the upper left, a second ear touches the top edge, and the long bridge of the nose extends toward the right side. The visible amber eye sits just above center, focused beyond the frame and edged by dark fur markings. Tawny brown and gray-beige fur covers the forehead and cheek, its short hairs rendered with fine individual texture rather than broad painted patches. The nose is dark and moist-looking, with a small highlight along its upper curve. Pale whisker pads and a white chin brighten the lower right, while fine whiskers project across the darker muzzle and surrounding grass. The left side of the neck dissolves into shadow and upright grasses, making the animal appear partially concealed rather than isolated against a studio backdrop. The grasses are sparse enough to leave the eye and muzzle clearly legible, yet their thin lines cross the cheek and lower edge in shallow layers. Low, directional light reaches the upper face from the left/front, warming the ear, brow, and nose ridge; the underside and background remain deeply shaded. The soft transitions of the fur contrast with crisp eye, whisker, and grass details. Color stays within a restrained range of black-brown, warm tawny gold, and cool gray. The overall composition is intimate and tense, drawing attention to a single alert eye held within a broad field of darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、自然主义的野生动物近景描绘一只雌狮的头部从近乎黑色的草丛中显现，以四分之三侧面朝向右方。背景几乎全黑，只有细而直立的草叶和几根隐约的茎能从阴影中辨认。动物头部占据画面大部分：一只圆耳在左上方升起，另一只耳朵触及上边缘，长长的鼻梁向画面右侧伸去。可见的琥珀色眼睛位于中央稍上方，凝视画外，周围有深色皮毛纹理勾勒。黄褐色与灰米色皮毛覆盖额头和脸颊，短毛以细小的单根纹理表现，而不是宽阔的绘画色块。鼻头深色，带湿润光感，上缘弧线有一小道亮点。浅色胡须垫与白色下巴点亮右下区域，细胡须横越较暗的口鼻和周围草叶。颈部左侧消融在阴影与直立草中，使动物像是部分藏身其间，而非被单独放在影棚背景前。草不算密，眼睛和口鼻仍清晰可读，但细线层层掠过脸颊与下缘。低角度的定向光从左前方照到上半张脸，让耳朵、眉骨和鼻梁转暖；下方与背景保留深影。皮毛的柔软过渡同眼睛、胡须与草叶的清晰细节形成对照。色彩保持在黑棕、暖黄褐金与冷灰的克制范围。整体构图亲密而紧张，把注意力引向大片黑暗中唯一警觉的眼睛。
style_prompt_en: The naturalistic image treatment concentrates detail inside a narrow pool of directional light and lets the surrounding field fall almost to black. Warm tawny and muted gold tones meet cool gray-brown shadows without saturated accents. Fine, discrete surface marks describe short texture, while delicate linear strands cross the darker areas and add shallow depth. Selective sharpness makes a few small reflective highlights and edges more prominent than the broad softly graded masses around them. The nearest forms remain dimensional through gentle tonal modeling; their boundaries partly disappear where darkness closes in. Lighting feels low and focused, with controlled falloff rather than evenly filled shadows. The composition relies on close cropping, strong asymmetrical weight, and substantial negative space. The overall effect is quiet, tactile, and watchful, grounded in realistic texture and restrained contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 这种自然主义影像处理把细节集中在狭窄的定向光区内，让周围区域几乎沉入黑色。暖黄褐与低饱和金色连接冷灰棕阴影，没有饱和色重音。细小而分立的表面笔迹表现短促肌理，纤细线状痕迹横越暗部，增加浅层纵深。选择性的清晰度使少数小反光与边缘比周围宽阔的柔和渐层体块更加醒目。近处形体借温和明度塑造保持体积，其边界在黑暗逼近处部分消失。光线低而集中，阴影有受控衰减，不被均匀填亮。构图依靠紧密裁切、强烈的不对称重量和充足负空间。整体效果安静、有触感且充满警觉，立足于写实肌理与克制对比。
theme_en: A lioness emerging from dark grass in close profile
theme_zh: 一只雌狮从暗草中显出的近景侧脸
name: Beverly Joubert
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
